# E-M5 III 1.7 Live ND photo (OM-5 port)

Test builds take a full Live ND shot from one press; not released.

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md) · **Project:** [Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)

**Firmware:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Mod build:** unpublished test builds (to 2026-11-19)

A port of the OM-5 1.2 Live ND shooting states and image-engine job 11 merges N frames at the set shutter speed into one photo, ND2 to ND16, from one press.

**Availability:** experimental branch. **Implementation basis:** reported.

## Supporting observations

- [E-M5 III 1.7: Live ND photos from test builds](../evidence/em5-iii-live-nd-photo.md) — physical camera; reported pass; partial report; not applicable.

## Limits

- Test builds only; none is published.
- Noise Reduction's dark-frame pass works at ISO 200 (2026-11-19); at ISO 3200 it reset the camera, and the fix is not tested yet.
- Rows in the camera's own menu exist and keep their values (see the saved-settings capability); letting them drive Live ND is not tested yet.
